Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production raster badge illustration for a casual aquarium game's level-up dialog.

Replace every grey checkerboard pixel in image 1 with this subtle warm ivory cream. There must be no checkerboard, no grey texture and no transparency simulation anywhere. Keep the same polished gold medallion, blank gold inner face, small teal kelp around the base, tiny grey base stones, two small gold stars and four subtle blue bubbles. Surrounding decorations remain close to medallion and within central 76% canvas width and 78% height. Subtle soft upper-left light and gentle shading. Soft warm cheerful style.
Critical constraints: NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO digit, NO star embossed in center. NO label, banner, rays, harsh glow, halo, frame, buttons, full scene, sand platform or watermark. Background must remain matching warm cream and completely empty at all canvas edges.
notes: Original generated image retained. No alpha extraction, checkerboard removal, pixel edits or resizing applied.
